# Energy billing: compliance and scope

| Ref | Obligation |
|---|---|
| C1 | Meter readings must be accepted from customers at any time, under the Supply Licence. |
| C2 | Customers in arrears must not be disconnected during winter months, under the Utility Customers Code. |

## Backlog

US-1 As a customer, I want to compare this year's usage with last year's so that I can cut back.
US-2 As a customer, I want to pay my bill by direct debit so that it is automatic.
US-3 As a customer, I want to set up a payment plan so that I can spread a large bill.
US-4 As a customer, I want to submit a meter reading whenever I like so that my bill is accurate.
constraints: Meter readings must be accepted from customers at any time, under the Supply Licence.
Customers in arrears must not be disconnected during winter months, under the Utility Customers Code.
